appDesc.message: Local bridge extension: lets authorised local agents read and operate open tabs in the background, without switching tabs or stealing focus.

statusOnlineNoExt.message: Bridge service online, but extension not connected

marksHint.message: Marks add 🤖 before the tab title and a dot on the icon, showing which pages an agent is operating on.

noOriginsHint.message: Before reading a web page, authorise its site below

advHeading.message: Optional permissions (off by default, granted separately):

permCookies.message: cookies — read cookies from open tabs, including httpOnly (session action; once granted, applies to all sites)

advHintPost.message: (reads login cookies and site storage). Without it that action returns a clear message; everything else is unaffected.

debuggerNote.message: debugger is a required permission (Chrome does not allow it as optional). It backs upload (filling local files into file inputs) and screenshot (element, full-page and background-tab captures). While the debugger is attached, Chrome shows an infobar at the top — that is normal.

tokenHint.message: The bridge generates a token on first start. Paste it here so the extension can authenticate.

localNote.message: Connects only to local 127.0.0.1; no external network. Can read page content and click and type within the granted scope.

extIdNote.message: The bridge only allows extension IDs on its allowlist. If the server log says this extension was rejected, start it with --allow-extension <ID above>.

alertInvalidOrigin.message: Enter a valid site, e.g. confluence.example.com

confirmGrantAll.message: This grants permission to read page content on all websites. Continue?

confirmRevokeAll.message: This revokes all revocable site grants (default-authorised entries are unaffected). Continue?
